title: PINK MALL Product Creative Contract

dependsOn.dependency: Contract 01 decides whether a product appears at role NONE, DETAIL, SUPPORTING or HERO. This contract governs what must hold once a real product is present at any role other than NONE. It MUST NOT duplicate contract 01.

inheritance: Inherits every rule of the System Authority Contract and MUST NOT contradict it. Status is provenance only; canonicality is decided by the parent's canonicalityRule, not by this field and not by file existence.
purpose: Define the product-fidelity constitution that governs creative work depicting a real PINK MALL product, before any paid generation infrastructure is activated. It says what a generator may transform, what it may never transform, what evidence is authoritative for product shape, and what must be true before a generated depiction may be treated as anything other than a candidate.

covers: product-fidelity rules for creative depiction of a real SKU
product geometry evidence versus wear/fit reference
the Product Reference Package handed to a future generator
clothing worn on a body as a high-risk product class
structural QA gates and failure vocabulary
the authority boundary around an execution/generation provider
doesNotCover: product identity, price, sizes, variant or canonical commerce media, which remain owned by the authorities in contract 00 and the Product Onboarding system
which campaign idea is selected, which belongs to contract 01
approval, publication, spend and retry-credit authority, which belong to contract 06
human identity evidence and consent, which belong to the Avatar authority and its consent gate
any implementation of a Product Creative Engine, Clothing Fit checker or QA method
scope.note: No Product Creative Engine exists. Nothing here is implemented. This contract is authoring only.

corePrinciple.statement: World physics may break. Product truth may not. Human identity may not.
corePrinciple.rule: The creative world may transform around a real product. The product itself may not be redesigned.

productFidelity.honestDefinition: 1:1 product fidelity does NOT mean a generated image is a pixel-identical copy of a catalogue photograph. It means the generator receives NO authority to redesign the product: the depiction must remain recognisable as the same exact product, in the same exact variant, with its intrinsic construction intact.
mustRemainTheSame: logos, wordmarks and graphics where visible
hardware, closures, handles, straps, soles, lenses, frames, stitching and pattern placement where applicable and established
productFidelity.mustNotInvent: Factual attributes Product Truth has not established MUST NOT be invented to fill a gap in the depiction.

repositoryPrecedent.note: The onboarding policy already forbids recolour, reshape, logo change, print change, sole change, hardware addition or removal, stitching change, proportion change, hallucinated angles and feature addition or removal on canonical ecommerce images. This contract carries that same discipline into generated campaign media rather than inventing a second standard.

productTruthAuthority.rule: This contract MUST NOT become a second product database.
rules: A creative system MAY READ Product Truth.
A creative system MUST NOT WRITE Product Truth.
A generated image is NEVER evidence that Product Truth changed.
A depiction that disagrees with Product Truth is a defect in the depiction, never a correction to the product.

evidenceRoles.definition: Authoritative visual evidence for what the product actually is. For a real SKU it MUST derive from the actual verified product.
evidenceRoles.inheritedFrom: docs/pink-mall/avatar-skill/v1.3/SKILL.md — 'Product geometry is not a wear reference'

authoritativeFor: approximate interaction with a human body
evidenceRoles.definition: Describes placement and human interaction only. It MAY inform placement and MUST NOT override product geometry.
evidenceRoles.inheritedFrom: docs/pink-mall/avatar-skill/v1.3/SKILL.md — 'Product geometry is not a wear reference'

neverGeometryAuthority: avatar photographs and any avatar frame
a different colourway of the same model
a generated image, including one this system produced
evidenceRules: productGeometrySource and productWearReference are distinct and MUST NOT be merged.
An avatar reference MUST NOT be converted into Product Truth.
A wear reference MAY inform placement while remaining non-authoritative for exact product construction.
A visually similar SKU is NEVER acceptable as geometry evidence.
A different colourway is NEVER acceptable as geometry evidence.

productLockCategories.definition: The depiction is of this exact product and no other.
The depiction is of this exact variant and colourway.
The outer shape and overall form of the product.
The intrinsic three-dimensional form and the relationship of its parts.
How the product is physically built.
The relative sizes of the product's components to one another.
The established colours of the product and their placement.
Logos, wordmarks, graphics and printed identifiers where visible.
The features that make this product recognisable as itself.

productLockRules: Every core lock applies whenever a real product appears at role DETAIL, SUPPORTING or HERO.
A later contract MAY add category-specific locks. It MUST NOT silently weaken a core lock.
A lock is not a numeric tolerance. Exact computer-vision thresholds are OPEN and are not set here.
Locks constrain the product. They do not constrain the world around it.

creativeEnvelope.principle: CREATIVE FREEDOM applies to the WORLD. PRODUCT LOCK applies to the PRODUCT.
creativeEnvelope.styleIsNotNarrowed: PINK MALL MUST NOT be narrowed into a single visual style by this contract. Heritage and brand-fit constraints belong to the Avatar heritage authority and contract 01; this contract constrains product fidelity only.
creativeEnvelope.rule: A creative system MAY transform the world. It MUST NOT intentionally redesign the product.

productConfidence.rule: A product-led task without an adequate productGeometrySource cannot claim high product confidence. Confidence describes how well grounded the task is; it is NOT permission to generate.

mandatoryDowngrades.condition: no productGeometrySource for a product-led task
mandatoryDowngrades.precedent: Avatar Skill v1.3: 'A product-led task without a productGeometrySource sets productConfidence: LOW and warns.'

mandatoryDowngrades.condition: geometry evidence is a similar SKU rather than the exact SKU
geometry evidence is a different colourway
geometry evidence exists but omits a lock category that is visible in the intended depiction
body-worn clothing without sufficient garment-geometry evidence

productConfidence.honesty: An uncertain product MUST NOT be reported as fully grounded. Declare the uncertainty instead.

productRoleInteraction.rule: Contract 01 decides the role. When the role is NONE there is no real product to lock and this contract imposes nothing: not every campaign is product-led. When the role is DETAIL, SUPPORTING or HERO, every rule here applies in full — a product shown as a DETAIL is still the real product.

highRiskProductClasses.reason: Garment geometry and human-body geometry interact, so a generator can preserve apparent colour while still changing the garment.

highRiskRules: Clothing worn on a human body is a HIGH-RISK product-fidelity case and requires the Clothing Fit Protocol.
Preserved colour is NOT evidence of preserved garment geometry.
A complete per-category risk taxonomy is NOT defined here. Other categories remain OPEN unless repository evidence already locks them.

evidenceKinds.definition: Evidence for what the garment itself is: cut, length, neckline, sleeves, waist, seams, closures and construction.
Evidence for how the exact garment interacts with a body: drape, sit, movement and placement.

rules: Garment geometry still comes from exact-product evidence.
Body and avatar references are NEVER garment-geometry authority.
Calibration-photograph wardrobe is NEVER styling authority and NEVER garment authority.
A similar garment is NOT evidence for the real SKU.
Fit evidence MAY inform how the exact garment interacts with a body.
Fit evidence MUST NOT redesign the garment.
If critical fit evidence is absent, the uncertainty MUST be declared rather than invented.

outcomes.meaning: Garment geometry evidence covers the depiction and the depiction is consistent with it.
The depiction contradicts the garment geometry evidence.
Required garment-geometry or fit evidence is insufficient to decide. This is a BLOCKED state, never a silent PASS.

forbiddenResolutions: silently simplifying a distinctive product feature
dualLock.rule: When a campaign contains INA, SIS or DUO together with a real product, two independent locks operate at once. Neither may be sacrificed to preserve the other. If the generator cannot satisfy both, the candidate is REJECTED — the conflict is not resolved by editing either side.

consent.rule: Commercial publication of a generated likeness is governed by the Consent Gate. This contract REFERENCES that authority and MUST NOT resolve it. Current consent state is NOT cached here: it MUST be read from the authority at the time it matters, so that resolving consent there never leaves this contract stale or contradicting it. Controlled internal validation and commercial publication are different operations and are not interchangeable.

generatedOutputStatus.rule: A generated product image begins as GENERATED_OUTPUT / CANDIDATE. It does not become fact, canonical product media, an approval or a publication merely because generation succeeded. A future QA layer must validate it before any further transition, and approval and publication authority remain with contract 06.

rules: CANONICAL_COMMERCE_MEDIA belongs to Product Truth, is acquired and approved through product onboarding, and MUST NOT be generatively altered.
CAMPAIGN_MEDIA may be generated, may place the real product inside an imaginative world and may use surreal composition.
CAMPAIGN_MEDIA is NOT canonical commerce photography and MUST NOT silently replace it.
CAMPAIGN_MEDIA MUST NOT be promoted into Product Truth merely because it looks convincing.
DERIVATIVE_MEDIA retains the parent contract's definition and authority boundaries.

qaGates.evaluates: Human Truth integrity when a person is present

qaRules: Applicability is decided first. A gate that does not apply is marked NOT_APPLICABLE and returns no result.
A gate that applies returns PASS, FAIL or UNRESOLVED. UNRESOLVED is a real outcome and MUST NOT be recorded as PASS.
A gate that applies MUST NOT be marked NOT_APPLICABLE in order to bypass it.
No numeric pass percentage, tolerance or similarity threshold is defined by this contract.
QA evaluates the depiction. It never revises Product Truth.
numericThresholdNote: Avatar Skill v1.3 carries its own test-phase gate (productFidelity >= 8) in FAILURE_TAXONOMY.json F04. That number belongs to that skill's test rubric, which its own SKILL.md calls a test default rather than immutable truth. It is cited here as existing precedent and is deliberately NOT promoted into this contract as a constitutional threshold.

hardFailures.definition: The depiction is of a different product than the one named.
The depiction is of a different variant or colourway than the one named.
Shape, colour, logo, hardware or proportions deviate from the authoritative geometry evidence.
How the product is built has changed: seams, stitching, panels, sole or closure construction.
A feature that makes the product recognisable has been removed, added or simplified.
The depiction asserts a product fact that contradicts Product Truth.
The depiction contradicts Human Truth for INA, SIS or DUO.
Required evidence is insufficient to decide a body-worn clothing depiction.
Generic, similar-SKU, different-colourway or avatar evidence was treated as exact product authority.
An execution or generation layer was treated as authoritative for product truth, human identity, approval or publication.

failedGenerationIsNot: permission to weaken a Product Lock
proof that the canonical product reference is wrong
retrySemantics.rule: A failed generation is evidence about the attempt, not about the product. Any retry MUST preserve the same underlying Product Truth unless that truth is separately corrected through its own authority system. Spend and correction-credit approval belong to contract 06 and no credit ceiling is defined here.
retrySemantics.precedent: docs/pink-mall/avatar-skill/v1.3/SKILL.md — 'One failed generation is evidence about the pipeline, not permission to rewrite the identity system.'

executionLayer.rule: An execution layer executes. It does not become an authority by producing output. This contract's validity does not depend on an activated subscription or on any specific API implementation: the authority boundary holds whether or not a provider is connected.

authorityGrants.note: Contract 02 grants no publication, spend or approval authority. Those belong to contract 06 and to the parent's own domains.

productReferencePackage.note: The package is a GENERATION INPUT assembled before generation. It is not a new Product Truth record, and its builder is NOT implemented in this phase. Instances are snapshots and MUST NOT be committed to this public repository.

privacyRules: Contract, schemas, vocabularies, validation rules, generic QA logic and synthetic fixtures are public-safe.
Unpublished real campaign creative and private campaign strategy MUST NOT be committed here.
Private character material and private generated likeness output MUST NOT be committed here.
Credentials, API keys and execution-provider tokens MUST NOT be committed here.
Private customer and performance data MUST NOT be committed here.
PINK-MALL-OPS remains PLANNED and MUST NOT be created.
openItems: per-category risk taxonomy beyond the locked clothing risk
openItemsRule: These are genuinely undecided. They MUST NOT be answered by invention, and a later system MUST NOT assume a default for any of them.
changeControl: Durable change follows the parent's change-control protocol: classify, update the candidate, validate, independent review, then promote to canonical development.

qaSemantics.rule: Applicability and result are two dimensions, not one vocabulary. A gate that APPLIES returns PASS, FAIL or UNRESOLVED. NOT_APPLICABLE marks a gate that does not apply to the depiction at all; it is NOT a fourth evaluation result and asserts nothing about quality.
qaSemantics.mustNotBypass: A gate that applies MUST NOT be marked NOT_APPLICABLE to bypass it. Marking an applicable gate NOT_APPLICABLE is a governance defect, not a result.
qaSemantics.obligationRule: Every gate is registered for evaluation in the pre-generation package via mustEvaluateIfApplicable = true. That is an OBLIGATION, not an applicability result: it says the gate must be evaluated if it applies. A pre-generation package MUST NOT waive a gate, and MUST NOT resolve applicability — whether a gate legitimately does not apply is decided after generation, using qaGates[].mayBeNotApplicable and the notApplicableMarker.

blockedWhen: the only geometry evidence is a similar SKU
the only geometry evidence is a different colourway
a body-worn clothing depiction lacks garment-geometry evidence
generationReadiness.rule: Product confidence and generation readiness are different judgements. LOW product confidence is a confidence STATEMENT, not permission to generate. No Product Reference Package may be emitted for generation while readiness is BLOCKED, which is why the package schema requires at least one exact-product geometry source: a package that cannot name the product's geometry evidence cannot be assembled at all.
generationReadiness.avatarCompatibility: Avatar Skill v1.3 sets productConfidence LOW for a product-led task with no productGeometrySource. That mapping is preserved verbatim. This contract adds the readiness gate alongside it rather than replacing it.
